She eventually said it made her feel embarrassed and literally said that it's silly for a 23 year old man to be wearing a neon purple hat saying 'pierce the veil' on it (a band). We haven't really spoke since and she's clearly annoyed, but I think I was pointing out a very clear double standard, so if I'm an asshole then she's an asshole as well. But it's over to yoh reddit, AITA?
